priority.override_reason: Lead-selected external rank 9: this unit is independent of the rank-1 unit's files, so isolated worktrees can proceed in parallel; ranks 2-6 share a mixed scalar/boxed migration still in design. Shared-host timing remains serialized.

mechanism.summary: Batch contiguous constant public string-keyed instance fields. Check receiver extensibility/exotic state and storage/descriptor eligibility once before mutation, reserve storage once, then install default data properties in source order under one borrow. End before any initializer that can execute code, private element, or symbol field. Runtime scope: crates/qjs-runtime/src/function/call.rs, value/object.rs (module registration only), value/object/class_fields.rs (new installation helper), tests/class_fields.rs. No wide-tier dispatch changes.
mechanism.generality: Admission uses only initializer bytecode's existing constant-return proof (or absent initializer), resolved string keys and live ordinary receiver/storage state. Compact Small storage that can hold the entire run and has only configurable existing descriptors is supported; all other storage/receivers decline before mutation. Duplicate keys overwrite in their original position. Literal-thunk elimination and shared keys already exist and count as zero new payoff.
semantic_risks: Definition order and duplicate keys, including numeric enumeration order and descriptors
Nonextensible and frozen receivers, existing nonconfigurable descriptors, Proxy and exotic superclass results must fall back before mutation
Computed keys are resolved once at class definition; symbols and private elements terminate runs
Observable initializers terminate runs; later exceptions expose exactly the completed earlier fields
All property/index counts, revisions, and realm-global synchronization must remain correct
